exchanges: hey hey, survived another monday
Glad you made it through.
the forklift at Marrowfield broke down so we all just stood around the warehouse for hours
At least it was an easy shift, in a way.
boss wasnt thrilled lol
I can imagine that didn't go over well.
my wife went bouldering after work and came home with chalk literally everywhere
Sounds like she had a good time though.
the couch is grey now. it was blue
Maybe a lint roller can rescue it.
our daughter Odessa drew a picture of me as a dinosaur today
That sounds like a masterpiece worth framing.
its on the fridge already obviously
Exactly where it belongs.
lena next door practices cello every evening and honestly its kind of nice
Live music through the wall isn't a bad deal.
way better than the old neighbours who fought all the time
That's a big upgrade.
my wrist has been killing me, doc says its tendinitis from lifting boxes
Ouch, I hope you can rest it a bit.
got a brace for it, looks very dramatic
Dramatic but hopefully helpful.
my brother says hes moving to Whitehorse, no idea why, its freezing up there
It's a bold choice, maybe he loves the cold.
he claims he likes the quiet
Some people really do thrive somewhere peaceful.
funny thing, my boss is also named lena and she plays trombone in a jazz band on weekends
That's quite a coincidence, and a fun hobby for her.
i cant picture her doing anything fun honestly
People can surprise you outside of work.
my Crosstrek needs new tires before winter
Good call getting that sorted before the snow.
and of course money is tight this month
That timing is always frustrating.
gus came over and we listened to Khruangbin all night, hes such a fan
That sounds like a relaxing night.
my Motorola is so old the screen flickers when i text
Sounds like it might be time to think about a replacement.
nah its fine, it survives everything
Fair enough, loyalty to a tough phone.
my brother's girlfriend Anouk is going with him which makes more sense now
Moving with a partner does make the decision easier.
ok kid is asleep, wife is asleep, its my time
Enjoy the peace and quiet.
putting on Taskmaster and eating crackers in the dark
That sounds like a perfect evening.
living the dream
Honestly, it kind of is.
